description: Use Prometheus and the dptech_exporter to collect the statistics of DPtech network devices and display the statistics of DPtech network device.

targets.expr: dptech_if_in_bps{host="$host", iftype=~"$iftype"} and on(ifname) (topk(5, delta(dptech_if_in_bytes{host="$host", iftype=~"$iftype"}[$__range])>0))
dptech_if_out_bps{host="$host", iftype=~"$iftype"} and on(ifname) (topk(5, delta(dptech_if_out_bytes{host="$host", iftype=~"$iftype"}[$__range])>0))
dptech_if_in_discards_pps{host="$host", iftype=~"$iftype"} and on(ifname) (topk(5, delta(dptech_if_in_discards{host="$host", iftype=~"$iftype"}[$__range])>0))
dptech_if_in_errors_pps{host="$host", iftype=~"$iftype"} and on(ifname) (topk(5, delta(dptech_if_in_errors{host="$host", iftype=~"$iftype"}[$__range])>0))
dptech_if_out_errors_pps{host="$host", iftype=~"$iftype"} and on(ifname) (topk(5, delta(dptech_if_out_errors{host="$host", iftype=~"$iftype"}[$__range])>0))
